Book Orbit is a self-hosted app for books and audiobooks that pulls in the pieces you would normally run three or four separate tools for. Collection tracking, a built in e-reader, an audiobook player, metadata management, and request handling that works a lot like Sonarr or Radarr but for books. In this guide we walk the whole UI, then get into how I actually have it running with Docker Compose, a network share off unRAID, and nginx proxy manager. Full write up and every link is down below.

Book Orbit: https://techhut.tv/bookorbit-self-hosted-library
Audiobookshelf: https://techhut.tv/apps/audiobookshelf
Nginx Proxy Manager + NetBird Guide (good prerequisite): https://github.com/TechHutTV/homelab/tree/main/netbird
